name: com.ezoic.cmp-sdk
description: Ezoic's consent management (CMP) for Unity apps of Ezoic publishers that don't use the Ezoic Ads package: the IAB TCF consent dialog in GDPR regions and the privacy notice and "Do Not Sell" choice in covered US states, through a simple C# API. Apps that use com.ezoic.ads already have it; use one of the two. Requires the External Dependency Manager (EDM / EDM4U) to resolve the native Android library and iOS Swift package, or a manual Gradle dependency / Xcode Swift package (see the README). Android: Minimum API Level 24. iOS: iOS 15+, Xcode 26.2+.

samples.description: One MonoBehaviour with an IMGUI control panel that initializes the CMP, asks for consent, opens the privacy settings and resets consent while logging every result.
